content:
**Owlet Nuggets** are a consumable item in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wastelanders* update.

Chunks of Owlet Meat that have been cooked. They give a 30 minute boost to Intelligence while restoring a moderate amount of HP and hunger at the cost of a low dose of rads.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Owlet Meat (1) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned on pickup Owlet Meat | | Owlet Nuggets (1) | 

Can be crafted at any Cooking Station with the correct ingredients after pickeding up Owlet Meat for the first time.
